mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.used_count, b.reserved_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.state = 'consumed' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS actual_used, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.state = 'reserved' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS actual_reserved FROM quota_bucket b LEFT JOIN quota_entry e ON e.enterprise_id = b.enterprise_id AND e.bucket_id = b.id WHERE b.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} GROUP BY b.id, b.used_count, b.reserved_count HAVING b.used_count <> actual_used OR b.reserved_count <> actual_reserved ORDER BY b.id
